do_not_use_when: An unprescribed exclusion: use search-statistics for 95% CLs.
A differential spectrum with covariance: use differential-likelihood.

examples.phrase: Synthetic example: two experiments, per-bin Gaussian background nuisances, signal proportional to g^4.

use_when: Evaluate the statistic a request prescribes (closed-form significance, delta log-likelihood threshold, per-bin profile likelihood).
The prescribed quantity is the primary result and CLs may accompany it.
